definitions.gloss: norm; usual state; what is ordinary
definitions.explanation: What is normal, customary, or to be expected. Often appears in set patterns describing how things typically are, or as {常|つね}に (always) adverbially.

examples.english: That's the way of the world.

examples.japanese: ⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{常|つね}だ。
examples.english: Failure is to be expected from young people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{常|つね}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{冷静|れいせい}→冷静：03781_reisei⟧で⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧よう⟦{心|こころ}がけている→心がける：10015_kokorogakeru⟧。
examples.english: He always tries to stay calm.

notes:
A somewhat literary noun. Most common as part of fixed patterns: 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{常|つね} (the way of ~), {常|つね}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (always), or ⟦{常々|つねづね}→常々：27906_tsunezune⟧ (regularly, all the time).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{世|よ}→世：00424_yo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{常|つね}: the way of the world
- ~⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{常|つね}: typical of, what's normal for ~
- {常|つね}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: always (adverbial)
- ⟦{常|つね}{日頃|ひごろ}→常日頃：18708_tsunehigoro⟧: regularly; in everyday life

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧: always — everyday, conversational
- ⟦{普段|ふだん}→普段：00041_fudan⟧: usually; in ordinary times — concrete daily routine
- {常|つね}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: always — formal, written; same kanji used adverbially
